title: 终端短路的无损耗线：短路的消息要走一个来回
statement: 无损耗空气线 Z_c = 50 Ω，长 l = 300 m，v = 3×10⁸ m/s，终端短路，原来不带电。t = 0 时接通 U_s = 10 V（阶跃），内阻 R_s = 50 Ω。
x 从始端量起；电流 i 沿 +x 方向为正；各时刻取波前刚过之后的值。

questions.ask: 0 < t < 2 µs 时始端电流 i(0, t) = ?
questions.explain: R_s = Z_c：u⁺ = 10 × 50/100 = 5 V，i⁺ = 5/50 = 0.1 A。终端短路的消息要等反射波回到始端（t = 2T = 2 µs）才能“传回来”，在此之前电源看到的只是 Z_c。

questions.ask: t = 1.2 µs 时线路中点的电压 u(150 m) = ?
questions.explain: T = l/v = 1 µs。入射波 0.5 µs 到达中点；终端反射波（Γ_2 = −1，−5 V）1.5 µs 才到中点：1.2 µs 时 u = 5 V。

questions.ask: t = 1.8 µs 时中点电压 u(150 m) = ?
t = 1.8 µs 时中点电流 i(150 m) = ?
questions.explain: 反射波电流 = −u⁻/Z_c = +0.1 A，与入射波电流同向相加：0.1 + 0.1 = 0.2 A。

questions.ask: t = 2.5 µs 时电源内阻 R_s 中的电流 = ?
questions.explain: 2T 时反射波到达始端，被 R_s = Z_c 全部吸收（Γ_1 = 0），之后线上不再变化：i = U_s/R_s = 0.2 A，与终端短路的直流解相同。

questions.ask: 为什么这个电路在 t = 2T 之后就直接到达稳态，没有来回振荡？
choices: 因为 R_s = Z_c，Γ_1 = 0：回到始端的波被完全吸收
choiceExplain: 短路端的反射系数是 −1，不是 0。
对：源端匹配，反射波到此为止。
无损耗线上的波不会衰减；如果两端都不匹配，波会一直来回反射。
questions.explain: 稳态需要波不再反射。终端 Γ_2 = −1（全反射），但始端 Γ_1 = 0，所以每个波最多只反射一次。

hints: 先求第一个波：线路对电源相当于电阻 Z_c。
终端短路 Γ_2 = −1：反射波电压与入射波相反，反射波电流（−u⁻/Z_c）与入射波电流同号。
单程时间 T = l/v；某点在 x/v 时入射波到达，在 (2l − x)/v 时反射波到达。
solution: **3. 始端。** 2T = 2 µs 反射波到达，被 R_s = Z_c 吸收：之后 u_1 = 0，i = **0.2 A** = U_s/R_s，达到稳态。
**检查：** 直流下无损耗线就是两根导线，终端短路时电源电流 = U_s/R_s = 0.2 A ✓。

en.title: Lossless line with a shorted end: news of the short takes a round trip
statement: A lossless air line, Z_c = 50 Ω, length l = 300 m, v = 3×10⁸ m/s, has its end shorted and is initially uncharged. At t = 0 a step U_s = 10 V with internal resistance R_s = 50 Ω is connected.
x is measured from the start; the current i is positive in +x; values are taken just after a wavefront has passed.

questions.ask: Current at the start for 0 < t < 2 µs, i(0, t) = ?
questions.explain: R_s = Z_c: u⁺ = 10 × 50/100 = 5 V, i⁺ = 5/50 = 0.1 A. The news of the short only comes back with the reflected wave at t = 2T = 2 µs; until then the source sees just Z_c.

questions.ask: Voltage at the midpoint at t = 1.2 µs, u(150 m) = ?
questions.explain: T = l/v = 1 µs. The incident wave reaches the midpoint at 0.5 µs; the wave reflected at the short (Γ_2 = −1, −5 V) only arrives at 1.5 µs: at 1.2 µs u = 5 V.

questions.ask: Midpoint voltage at t = 1.8 µs, u(150 m) = ?
questions.explain: 5 + (−5) = 0 V: the reflected wave wipes the voltage out.

questions.ask: Midpoint current at t = 1.8 µs, i(150 m) = ?
questions.explain: The reflected wave carries −u⁻/Z_c = +0.1 A, adding to the incident current: 0.1 + 0.1 = 0.2 A.

questions.ask: Current in the source resistance R_s at t = 2.5 µs = ?
questions.explain: At 2T the reflected wave reaches the start and is absorbed completely by R_s = Z_c (Γ_1 = 0); nothing changes afterwards: i = U_s/R_s = 0.2 A, the DC answer for a shorted end.

questions.ask: Why does this circuit reach steady state right after t = 2T, without bouncing back and forth?
choices: Because the shorted end has Γ_2 = 0
Because R_s = Z_c gives Γ_1 = 0: the returning wave is absorbed completely
questions.explain: Steady state needs the waves to stop reflecting. The end has Γ_2 = −1 (total reflection), but the start has Γ_1 = 0, so every wave is reflected at most once.
choiceExplain: Right: the source end is matched and the reflected wave ends there.
On a lossless line waves never decay; with both ends mismatched they would bounce forever.

hints: First the launched wave: the line looks like a resistor Z_c to the source.
A short gives Γ_2 = −1: the reflected voltage is the negative of the incident one, while the reflected current (−u⁻/Z_c) has the same sign as the incident current.
One-way time T = l/v; at position x the incident wave arrives at x/v and the reflected one at (2l − x)/v.
solution: **2. Midpoint.** The incident wave arrives at 0.5 µs: u = **5 V**; the reflected wave (−5 V, +0.1 A) arrives at 1.5 µs: u = **0 V**, i = **0.2 A**.
**3. Start.** At 2T = 2 µs the reflected wave arrives and is absorbed by R_s = Z_c: from then on u_1 = 0 and i = **0.2 A** = U_s/R_s — steady state.
**Check:** at DC a lossless line is just two wires; with the end shorted the source current is U_s/R_s = 0.2 A ✓.
